newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE GRANTS OLYMPIC COMMITTEE 12004 TELEPHONE NUMBER.
newsitem.headline: OTE GRANTS OLYMPIC COMMITTEE 12004 TELEPHONE NUMBER.

text.p: OTE telecom has granted the Hellenic Olympic Committee a special five-digit telephone number, 12004, which can be reached without any other codes from anywhere in Greece as well as from mobile phones, it said.
Showing off its technical capabilities OTE said the number aimed to promote Greece in its quest for the 2004 Olympic Games. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
